title: a cancellation during a task's final async destroy does not interrupt it and does not change the result
purpose: Observe asynchronous behaviour through causal events.

stdout.text:
body done
cancel requested
conn closed
result 7 cancelled false

provenance.origin: authored for #739 from the #601 K2 probes; Sparrow (Tomato) is the reference behaviour
provenance.expected_basis: #739, K2 probe `finaldestroy`: the task's body has produced 7 and its scope's async destroy waits on an event when main cancels the task. The async destroy is shielded: it completes, the task keeps its result and is not cancelled.
